mapping.summary: Turns receipt shortages, damage and failed inspections into vendor claims, credits and scorecards.
claims: Raise claims from posted purchase receipt or warehouse receipt lines with data prefilled
Claim types for shortage, damage, wrong item and quality defect with photos
Failed Microsoft Quality Management inspections create claims automatically
Prevents claiming the same line twice
Standard approval workflow with auto-approval limit and no self-approval
Priority-based service levels with escalation of overdue claims
Claims are settled through a purchase return order or an allowance credit memo
Posted credits are reconciled against the claim
Tracks vendor responses with email notifications
Weighted vendor scorecard for quality, delivery, cost, responsiveness and compliance
Vendor certifications with expiry tracking and cost of quality by vendor
Per-seat plans with one-month trial; viewers free
